title: Health & pharmacy
body:
Emergency numbers: 110 for police, 119 for ambulance/fire — both free, 24/7, from any phone. For English-language help with an injury, illness, or general emergency, the Japan National Tourism Organization runs a 24/7 multilingual hotline: 050-3816-2787 (or +81-50-3816-2787 from a foreign line). A non-emergency medical advice line, #7119, triages whether a symptom needs a hospital visit.

A Matsumoto Kiyoshi pharmacy sits right in Fukuoka Airport's International Terminal (3F, 7:30–18:00) for anything forgotten on the flight over, with further branches at Tenjin (Mina Tenjin B1) and Canal City Hakata (B1F) for restocking mid-trip.

Check the current US State Department travel advisory for Japan before you go — the page blocks automated lookups, so it needs a direct visit rather than a link-and-trust.
